blocks.x: Twenty-fourth: The Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have said: Whoever would like to be granted long lifetime, victory over the enemies, and protection against violent death, must repeat this doxology three times at the very beginning of night and three times at the very beginning of morning:
سبحان اللّه ملء الميزان،و منتهى الحلم و مبلغ الرّضا،و زنة العرش
